hypothesis: A manifest-only plan can predict actual fresh-cache payload and logical output bytes, including archive-member amplification and aliases, without transfers.
primary_comparator: Pinned restore_experiments.py control flow; isolated tiny synthetic local restores with network calls stubbed.
primary_metric: Exact integer payload/cache/output agreement with controlled restores; complete current/historical metadata accounting.
minimum_useful_effect: Identify whole-archive transfer costs that path-size list mode does not report.
success_rule: All frozen synthetic controls pass; current full selection agrees with saved manifest counts, historical pending objects remain blocked; all disjoint first-two-component root selections account for the complete current snapshot.
futility_rule: Any inability to bind payload size/digest/locator or any false restorable status blocks the plan. Retain failures; do not relax expectations.

authorization.user_approval_reference: 2026-10-23 donor contribution request and later multiple-focused-PR permission; claim https://github.com/rohanarun/Super-1/issues/23
authorization.approved_resources: Stdlib metadata reads, unit tests and tiny synthetic local restore fixtures only. No real artifact fetch, model execution, dependency install or official-test access.
authorization.max_walltime: 60 minutes implementation/research, ending before 12:04 UTC; final session quarter reserved for verification.
authorization.local_cpu_budget: At most 600 CPU seconds total for new metadata/planner/control executions.

arms: unchanged restorer driven with tiny synthetic bytes and stubbed network
design.control_rationale: Alias deduplication, whole-archive member extraction, direct Git/release objects, pending status and malformed/inconsistent metadata are checked separately.
design.seed_selection_method: No seeded picker exists. E00 transfer-planning gap chosen from source inspection and current priorities. Synthetic fixtures deterministic.
design.compute_accounting: Measure CPU/wall time for metadata grid; no training/benchmark/model work.

data.dataset_versions: No dataset bodies opened; only pinned current/historical archive indexes and summaries.

execution.hardware: Existing local session CPU; no external/cloud resources.
execution.runtime_versions: Session Python standard library only; record exact version in terminal receipt.
execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: Parent owns this new run, report, additive registry/manifest entries and contributor row. Frozen parent unchanged.
execution.fidelity_tolerances: Exact integer and canonical JSON equality; no relaxed numerical tolerance.
canary_matrix: Archive member requires whole payload, not member bytes
Same payload/object aliases fetched once and copied to distinct outputs
Direct pinned Git and release objects
Mixed-location plan versus unchanged restorer using stubbed network
Missing archive mapping, unsupported kind, duplicate restore path, malformed digest or conflicting blob size errors
Input row order does not change canonical plan
Full current and historical selections; every disjoint first-two-component current root selection
execution.cost_estimate: Zero money/network payload. Metadata outputs only; <=10 MiB new result artifacts.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Metadata/functional contract only; no scientific metric or independent reproduction.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: Content aliases count separately in restored output, once in unique content; fetched blobs deduplicate exactly by cache digest as in source.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: No sampling inference; frozen full metadata inventory and deterministic synthetic controls.
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: Report every snapshot/root selection and every failure; no selection by favorable totals.

evidence.preservation_policy: Add new files; retain every parent byte and all original registry content/status. Never fetch or modify accepted results.

decision.reason: Prospective tooling protocol before planner implementation and selected-budget analysis.
decision.next_experiment: Implement bounded offline planner; any real restore requires a separate explicit exact transfer/storage approval.
